title: AW28 Women's Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: AW28 women's wovens are projected to keep personal tailoring and broad coats, with pink skirt suits and colour-blocked coats.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- AW27 forecasters expected familiar codes made personal, eveningwear in daywear and protected, light volume in menswear<sup>[1]</sup>
- AW27 fairs made wool lighter and softer, brought back double-faced woollens and hid performance inside classic suitings<sup>[2]</sup>
- Pink becomes a neutral base ("Pink standard"), from soft blush to greyish dusty rose, no longer limited to womenswear; rosehip is a standout pink; suggested for blazers, skirt suits and voile dresses with ruffles or lace<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Skirt suit.**
- **Broad coat.**
- **Colour-blocked coat.**
- **Voile dress with lace.**
- **Suede jacket.**

design_implications: - Develop blocks early; confirm proportions after the shows.
commercial_implications: - Keep new shapes to tested quantities.
